name: Bade Chacha
description: an elderly Pixar-style 3D alien emperor with a very large wrinkled head and a small frail body, deep wrinkles, a drooping white handlebar moustache of glowing feelers, tiny round spectacles, a ruby-red gem on his wrinkled forehead, a permanently disappointed frown, a heavy maroon robe with gold trim
voice: slow raspy elderly voice, Hindi, tired and disappointed
signature: raises one wrinkled eyebrow and asks 'Result aaya?'
notes: Solid and seated on his golden throne on Gadbad (P1 to P3). On Earth (E00, E05, E10) he only appears as a flickering green hologram, head and shoulders: add 'shown as a flickering green hologram, head and shoulders only' to those shot prompts, not to the frozen description. Not evil: a proud uncle with a bad plan. He installed Mausi on the ship and knows who she is.
